description: North Cowichan Water Utilities is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Municipality of North Cowichan. The Water Utilities dataset contains North Cowichan owned water mains, fittings, valves, services, reservoirs, facilities, fire hydrants, and pressure zones. This data may only be used under the terms of the Open Government License - Municipality of North Cowichan. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Municipality of North Cowichan. Its tags are water utilities. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, FGDB, GPKG, KMZ, OTHER. The portal shows 2022-04-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Municipality of North Cowichan. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
